title: Näppärä tapa hahmottaa menot
body: Tosi intuitiivista, kun päivän menot on kuin kellotaululla. Näpsäkkä ja toimiva äppi, suosittelen myös muille kuin ADHD-ihmisille :)
author: Kuulemma

title: Thank you!
body: This app has helps me to manage my days 🫶 Highly recommend!
author: adhd94

title: Absolute life saver
body: This app has completely changed my life from being a lazy person whose always late into a busy person I even got hired to Apple after almost missing the inter view but PiCal had my back.
author: --chicken--

title: Doesn’t work with Google
body: Does not show google calendars at all. With poor documentation and adhd friendly design promise it’s an instant delete. Two stars for at least showing ical, which I don’t use.
author: AllNickNamesAreTaken0987654321

title: Practical for combining calendars
body: I work as a freelancer and have several client related calendars. This app helps me keep tabs on all of them. Also I like the simple interface & clear design,
author: kd7533

title: Like it more and more
body: To make a new event I learned that you just swipe the timecircle, nice. Seems PiCal is now my my main calender on the phone, IPad version seems to still need developement.
author: Ponsi

title: Neat app with great visualization
body: Tried this for one week and then got the paid version to view all my calendars (the free version supports two calendars). The way the day is visualized pleases my eye and it is easy to see with one glimpse, how full the day is. Also, the way for adding new events has much more user friendly interface than the oem calendar app.
author: Vesa -81

title: Great app
body: Love the user interface and design, super easy to use!
author: samhelsinki

title: Tätä on odotettu ♥️
body: Vihdoin visuaalisille ihmisille selkeää ajan hallintaa. Kiitos!
author: Jard3k5

title: Visuaalisen ihmisen paras ystävä
body: Kaikki menot näkee kerralla ja nopea haku milloin on aikaa. Kiireiselle kunnon life saver!
author: Mariahelsinki
